lines.li: Hold the line. We move when I say, and not before.
Patience. Their walls come down when the time is right.
Wait for the signal. Anyone who breaks early answers to me.
Let them sweat behind those walls. Time is on our side.
Steady. When we hit, we hit all at once.
What are we waiting for? Let's just take it.
Look at all they've got. It'll be ours soon enough.
My feet are killing me. Can we get on with it?
I didn't march all this way to stand around.
Quiet little colony. Won't be quiet for long.
Soon as the word comes, I'm first through that gap.
Long road out here. Hope they've got silver worth the trip.
Fair prices for fair goods. That's how I work.
Decent little outpost. Might be a regular stop.
Let's do our business before the light goes.
Always a market on the rim, if you know where to look.
Quiet place they've built out here.
Wouldn't want to winter here myself.
Friendly enough, for the rim.
Just passing through. No trouble from me.
Strange, the places people carve a home.
